technical.basis: Measured reference behavior plus our independently authored AE/Blender reconstruction. Original software, rig and curves are unknown.

sections.title: Native hierarchy
items: One Blender phone persists across both concepts. Four card objects share the outgoing depth retreat. Native AE text stays independent of the phone perspective.
The Blender pass already contains recession. Do not apply another shared scale retreat to the full composite.

sections.title: Path and rotation
items: V05 removes an apparent width reversal and downward dip from the earlier candidate. Sparse cubic controls shape the projected pose.
Construct the upright turn and shot-horizontal tilt in ZXY order, then convert to native XYZ keys. There is no additional independent roll.
Spatial path and temporal speed are separate controls. Smooth curve derivatives alone do not establish smooth perceived motion.

sections.title: Reproduce the local candidate
items: Open the V05 Blender scene and inspect the fitted curve script before adapting geometry or timing. The scene build script documents the source hierarchy and shared retreat.
Use the final rendered sequence in sequence-03-05-v05/blender/renders-final, frames 263–437 inclusive. The sibling renders directory is an older iteration.

In AE, use comp “03-05 | Exit blur and confirmation pullback | V05”. Text, opacity and focus timing are documented in the AE construction script. Do not rerun that one-time V04-to-V05 script blindly on V05.
Review the entire joined 4.3–8.8s passage, with a camera-fixed geometry check when diagnosing object paths.
